subject: Next steps: clarify payflow, budget owners, and pricing expectations (Lumina Health)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@luminahealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: clarify payflow, budget owners, and pricing expectations (Lumina Health)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed:

- Expected monthly inference volume: roughly 20M–45M tokens (spikes to ~80M in peak week).
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: looking for something in the neighborhood of $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on latency and SLA.
- Budget range you signaled: $25k–$60k/month for initial pilot + growth runway.

To keep momentum, could you confirm two things for us:
1) Economic buyer (person who signs off on the budget/contract).
2) Primary finance or procurement contact who will own invoicing / PO / contract routing.

If you can share those names/emails I’ll:
- Put together a concise tiered quote with 1M token price bands and an estimate for monthly spend at 25M / 40M / 80M tokens.
- Drop in a one-page mutual action plan that maps milestones (pilot start, SLA review, production roll).

I attached our pricing options and a mutual action plan template for reference.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll circulate a draft quote by EOD tomorrow once I have the buyer/finance names.
- Schedule a 30-min procurement alignment call next week (suggest Wed or Thu).

Appreciate the clarity here — makes the procurement path much faster.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood-pricing-options.pdf (PDF, 4 pages); mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)

- Economic buyer: Anika Rao (CFO) — anika.rao@luminahealth.ai

I’ll check Marcus Patel’s calendar and propose times — best for us next week Tue–Thu afternoons PT.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@luminahealth.ai>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@luminahealth.ai>, Marcus Patel <procurement@luminahealth.ai>, Dina Shah <dina@luminahealth.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing summary + proposed procurement call times (Lumina Health)

Hi Samir / Anika / Marcus / Dina —

Thanks for confirming the right folks — looping you in so we can get procurement on the calendar. Per Samir’s ask, attached is a 1-page tiered pricing summary and a draft mutual action plan (both editable). High level:

Tier A — Pilot (0–10M tokens/month): $2,000 per 1M tokens (intro onboarding rate; limited burst)
Tier B — Production (10–50M tokens/month): $1,000 per 1M tokens
Tier C — Scale (50M+ tokens/month): $850 per 1M tokens

Estimated monthly spend examples (approx):
- 25M tokens = $25k/month (Tier B blended)
- 40M tokens = $40k/month
- Peak week spike to 80M estimated at $68k (mix of B + C pricing and overage policies)

Notes: these are indicative — final pricing will reflect latency SLO, retention settings, and whether you need a Dedicated pool vs hosted. If procurement prefers, we can convert this into a formal line-item quote and Subscription SOW.

Proposed procurement call slots (PT):
- Wed Jul 15, 2:00–2:30pm or 3:30–4:00pm
- Thu Jul 16, 10:00–10:30am or 1:00–1:30pm

Marcus Lin (cc) — can you advise if we should include a one-time onboarding credit (e.g., 25% credit on first month) to speed approval?

Samir — if any of those slots work, I’ll send a meeting invite and include a short agenda (pricing, contract path, timelines).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Attachments: quote-draft.xlsx (XLSX, draft pricing table); mutual-action-plan.xlsx (updated)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing summary + proposed procurement call times (Lumina Health) — internal ask

Folks — quick internal note after looping Lumina. Samir confirmed buyer and finance contacts; proposed times above.

Two internal asks before I send the invite:
1) Pricing enforcement / discounting: recommend we hold close to the Tier B/B-C split above. As a competitive move we could offer a 20% onboarding credit on first month only (not on committed months) — would like your blessing.
2) Contract path: given Lumina’s requirement for enterprise controls and potential PHI, suggest offering Dedicated as an option in SOW but price the hosted path by default. If we include Dedicated pricing, we should flag estimated lead time and any onboarding fees.

Also confirm who will own the legal/procurement thread on our side once procurement replies — is it Marcus Lin or Evelyn? I’ll keep coordinating the scheduling and initial quote.

If no objection, I’ll send the calendar invite to Lumina with the 30-min slot for Thu Jul 16, 1:00pm PT and include the draft pricing sheet.

—Priya

Quote attachments referenced earlier: quote-draft.xlsx (internal draft).
